title: Build a deep link
intro: Type a link and see what happens when someone clicks it.

show.title: Opens in that folder
show.detail: A new terminal opens Claude Code in the folder, with the prompt typed in. Nothing runs until Enter. cwd wins over repo.

trace.text: Opens with the prompt ready; flags it as coming from outside.

show.title: Opens in your clone
show.detail: Claude Code finds a clone of that repository where you've already run claude, and fills in the prompt.

trace.text: Opens in your local acme/web clone.

show.title: Opens with the prompt
show.detail: Without repo or cwd, it opens with the prompt ready to send.

fallback.title: Not a deep link
fallback.detail: This demo only scripts claude-cli://open links, with or without repo and cwd.

quiz.question: Does clicking a deep link run the prompt?
options: No, you press Enter to send it
quiz.explanation: The prompt is filled in, but nothing runs until you press Enter.
